story: Fort Yargo State Park is an 1,816-acre U.S. state park located in Winder, Georgia, situated between Athens and Atlanta. The park features a 260-acre lake with a public beach and a log fort built in 1793.
matters: The park hosts Camp Will-A-Way, an accessible camp designed for individuals with developmental disabilities, in partnership with Camp Twin Lakes.
name: Fort Yargo State Park
